name: lever one arm bent over row
description: A one arm row pulling the loaded end of a barbell anchored at the floor. It works the lats and upper back one side at a time.
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell in a corner or landmine and load the other end.
Stand beside the loaded end and hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Grip the bar just behind the plate with one hand, arm straight.
Row the bar toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.
